name: amdgpu-isa-builder
description: Build AMD's ISA reference manuals as per-page markdown for the amdgpu-isa plugin to search locally, and regenerate that plugin's corpus from public AMD sources: machine-readable ISA XML into a queryable SQLite database plus LLVM's gfx target map.
